'''Rebecca''' (Japanese: '''レベッカ''' ''Rebecca'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP155|Double-Time Battle Training!]]''.

Rebecca is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who competed in the [[Brussel Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] with her {{p|Shuckle}}. She made it all the way to the final round, but lost against [[Zoey]] and her {{TP|Zoey|Glameow}}.

This win against Rebecca gave Zoey her fifth and final [[Ribbon]], which qualified her to compete in the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]].
